== English Decipher comparison ==
The Glossary broadens the piloting bonus to anything Kithaba pilots. It moves the unchanged power formula to the end of the text. Both versions restrict deployment to Tatooine. Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=80 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 80. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=4 Decipher Errata], PDF page 4. Players Committee, 2023, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=119 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A], PDF page 119.
